[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra I.34 (Samādhipāda) — Pracchardanavidhāraṇābhyāṃ vā prāṇasya | Pages 334-336]

hyāṃ vā prāṇasya / Vāśabdo'pyarthe /
Ābhyām api cittasya prasādanaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ / Nāsikāpuṭābhyām iti / Ekatarapuṭenety arthaḥ
/ Prayatnaviśeṣād iti / Sūkṣmarūpeṇa yogaśāstroktarītyā / Vamanaṃ recanam ity arthaḥ /
Vidhāraṇaṃ kumbhakaṃ tac cārthāt pūraṇānantaram iti bodhyam, recanottaraṃ pūraṇaṃ vinā
vidhāraṇāsaṃbhavāt / Prāṇāyāma ity ukteḥ prāṇāyāmaś ca vijñāyo recakapūrakakumbhakāḥ // ity
ādismṛtibhis trayāṇām eva militānāṃ prāṇāyāmatvakathanād iti / Prāṇāyāma iti / Etac ca dvayaṃ
pūraṇāgarbhaṃ prāṇāyāma ity arthaḥ /
Pracchardanavidhāraṇe vyākhyāya samagrasūtrārtham āha-- tābhyām
